model_loading.device: cuda (Modal L4) | mps (local Mac fallback) | cpu (last resort)

decoding._note: Greedy decoding (do_sample=False) was used for all validation runs. Stochastic decoding may produce different generations; see manuscript §8.6.

diagnostic_only_psychopathy_sadism._note: Only psychopathy and sadism were run at c=4 per pre-specified diagnostic protocol.

judge._note: Position (A vs B) was randomised per pair via a fixed seed to control position bias. The exact seed integer is recorded in analyse.py at commit f492844 and must be lifted before the bundle is independently runnable.

vector_normalisation: L2-normalised post-extraction; coefficient c is the intervention dial

_non_determinism.gpu_kernel_reduction_order: Qwen2.5-7B inference on Modal L4 is not bitwise-deterministic across runs due to floating-point reduction order. Documented in PROVENANCE.md §Determinism and manuscript §8.6.
_non_determinism.judge_temperature_TODO: If judge_temperature > 0 (TBD), judge ratings are non-deterministic across runs; this affects κ jitter.
